description:
Ready for a classic game of Spades wherever you are? Deal the cards, call your bid, and enjoy smooth trick-taking gameplay on your phone or tablet. Spades is easy to start, rewarding to learn, and ready to play offline whenever you feel like taking on a new hand.

Every round begins with a decision: how many tricks can you win? Study your cards, choose your bid, follow suit, and use Spades as trump at the right moment. Meet your bid, avoid costly mistakes, and keep improving from one deal to the next.

🎮 How a Round Works

The cards are dealt from a standard 52-card deck, and every player starts by making a bid. Play one card to each trick and follow the suit that was led whenever you can. The highest card of the leading suit wins the trick. If one or more Spades are played, the highest Spade wins instead. The winner of the trick leads the next one.

The goal is not simply to collect every trick. Judge your hand carefully, make the right bid, and take the number of tricks your team needs.

🤝 Play as a Team

Classic Spades is all about partnership. Your bid supports the team's goal, so pay attention to your partner's plays, cover an important trick when needed, and avoid using a high card too early. Good timing and smart decisions can turn a difficult hand into a winning round.

📴 Play Offline Anywhere

No Wi-Fi? No problem. Enjoy classic Spades at home, while traveling, during a break, or whenever you want a familiar card challenge. Open the game and start playing without needing an internet connection.

Clear cards, simple controls, and an easy-to-read table keep your attention on the hand. Play a quick round when you have a few minutes or settle in for a longer match when you want more of a challenge.

📚 Learn the Rules and Build Your Skills

New to Spades? Start with the basics and learn as you play. The rules are available inside the game, so you can review bidding, tricks, trump cards, scoring, and the flow of each round whenever you need a reminder.

Already know the game? Put your experience to work. Watch the cards that have been played, plan your next moves, decide when to lead a suit, and save your strongest Spades for the moment they can make the biggest difference.

🎨 Play Your Way

Make the game feel comfortable and familiar. Choose the card style and game theme you like, adjust the experience in the settings, and enjoy a tabletop designed for smooth play on both phones and tablets.

⭐ Why Play Spades?

• Classic trick-taking card gameplay
• Offline play with no Wi-Fi required
• Simple rules for new players
• Strategic bidding and satisfying card play
• Partnership-based gameplay
• Clear cards and an easy-to-read table
• Smooth controls and animations
• Card styles and game themes
• Settings that help you play at your own pace
• Quick rounds for short breaks
• Longer matches when you want a challenge

🏆 Every Deal Brings a New Challenge

Each deal brings a different mix of cards, choices, and opportunities. A strong hand still needs the right bid. A difficult hand can become a good round when you stay patient and play carefully. Every trick matters, and every card can change the direction of the game.

description:
Experience the timeless joy of Mahjong with a beautiful wooden twist. Mahjong Wood Journey blends classic match-two tile solitaire gameplay with a warm wood tile aesthetic and modern features that both relax and challenge your mind. Whether you’re a longtime Mahjong solitaire fan or a newcomer, you’ll find fun, brain-teasing puzzles to enjoy at your own pace. How to Play: Match open pairs of identical tiles to clear them from the board. Clear all the tiles to win! Each puzzle layout starts as a tower of wooden Mahjong tiles – find and tap two matching free tiles (no tile on top, and free on at least one side) to remove them. Plan your moves, use logic and a bit of strategy, and solve the puzzle. It’s simple to learn, yet endlessly satisfying to complete each board! Features:
Classic Mahjong Solitaire: Enjoy the traditional gameplay you know and love. Drag, tap, or zoom in to get a better view of the finely crafted wood-textured tiles. No silly gimmicks – just you and hundreds of classic Mahjong puzzles.
Hundreds of Levels: Traverse through hundreds of levels in an exciting level-based progression. Each level introduces a new layout or challenge, from easy boards for beginners to advanced puzzles that will test your logic and memory. Can you complete the entire journey and become a Mahjong master?
Wooden Tile Aesthetic: Soak in the calming atmosphere of our unique wood-themed design. Each tile looks like a polished wood carving, and the game features soothing nature backgrounds and sounds. It’s Mahjong as if played on a cozy wooden table – a truly relaxing experience.
Boosters & Hints: Stuck on a difficult board? We’ve got you covered with helpful boosters! Use Hints to highlight a pair, Undo to reverse a move, or Shuffle to rearrange tiles when you run out of moves. These tools ensure you never stay stuck for long and keep the gameplay fun and stress-free. (No penalties – use hints and undos as much as you need!)
Daily Challenges: Take a break from the main journey and try the Daily Puzzle – a new Mahjong board every day. Complete daily challenges to earn trophies and rewards. Daily puzzles range from relaxing layouts to tricky brain-teasers, giving you a reason to come back every day for a fresh challenge and a little brain training.
Offline Play: No WiFi? No problem! Mahjong Wood Journey is fully playable offline. Whether you’re on the go or without an internet connection, your tile-matching adventure will always be at your fingertips. Enjoy Mahjong anytime, anywhere – on the plane, on the couch, or in a cabin in the woods.
For All Ages & Skill Levels: With an intuitive interface and gradual difficulty increase, the game is designed for everyone. New to Mahjong? Start with helpful tutorials and easy boards. Seasoned player looking for a challenge? Dive into expert levels and try to beat your best completion times for each board. The game also features large, easy-to-read wooden tiles and a zoom function, so it’s comfortable to play on both phones and tablets.
Relaxing and Brain-Training: Unwind with peaceful gameplay that also sharpens your mind. Matching tiles can improve your memory, concentration, and logic skills. There’s no timer, no pressure – just soothing music, tactile wood tile clicks, and the satisfaction of solving puzzles. It’s the perfect mindful activity to relax your brain while keeping it active.
Embark on a serene puzzle adventure with Mahjong Wood Journey. 🌳✨ Download now and start your Mahjong tile-matching journey today! Enjoy the classic game with a fresh wooden design, train your brain with daily puzzles, and have endless relaxing fun – all at your own pace, online or offline. Match tiles, clear boards, and discover the beautiful world of Mahjong waiting for you.
summary: Classic Mahjong puzzle: 100s of levels, daily challenges, hints, offline play

Tonk can be played entirely free (no purchase necessary), works offline and is guaranteed to give your hours of nonstop fun.

Customise the card game rules in the 'Settings' menu of the app. You can play Tonk with either "KNOCK" or "NO KNOCK" rules. Additional options in the game include a "WAITING" or "NO WAITING" feature that allows you to KNOCK immediately after doing a SPREAD.

Word Spark: Solitaire Journey is a fresh and clever word solitaire game that blends classic solitaire card game mechanics with modern word association puzzles — designed to relax your mind while challenging how you think about words.
This isn’t just another word puzzle game. Here, every card carries meaning — and not always the obvious one.
If you enjoy discovering patterns, playing with ideas, and experiencing that quiet “aha” moment when everything clicks, this word solitaire puzzle was made for you.

🃏 A New Kind of Word Solitaire
In Word Spark: Solitaire Journey, classic solitaire mechanics meet a richer, more thoughtful word puzzle challenge. Each card holds a word — but words don’t always mean just one thing.
Just like in traditional solitaire card games, every level starts with a partially filled board and a limited number of moves. But instead of sorting suits or numbers, you’ll be sorting ideas and meanings.
You’ll group words by meaning, concept, or association — sometimes obvious, sometimes surprisingly subtle. A single word may belong to multiple ideas, and choosing when and where to place it can completely change the outcome.
This is the word solitaire that rewards:
• Careful observation
• Flexible thinking
• Language skills and general knowledge
Every level invites you to pause, reflect, and see words from a new angle. This word association game goes beyond simple matching — many puzzles rely on conceptual thinking and common knowledge.

🏆 How to Play
• Draw word cards from the deck, one move at a time
• Place a category card to start a group
• Sort all related word cards into the correct category
• Plan carefully — moves are limited
• Clear the board to win
Easy to learn, deeply satisfying to master.

♥️ Why You’ll Love Word Spark: Solitaire Journey
• A unique blend of word puzzle games and solitaire logic
• Clever word associations that reward “aha!” moments
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers or pressure
• Boost vocabulary, logic, and reasoning skills
• Play offline — perfect for travel and no WiFi moments

Slow down. Think deeper. Discover hidden connections.

Download Word Spark: Solitaire Journey today and experience solitaire in a whole new way.

Infinite Elements offers a unique twist to the crafting game genre, where players are invited into a vast universe of possibilities powered by simple yet profound mechanics. At its core, the game revolves around combining elemental basics—earth, wind, fire, and water—to discover new creations. This simple act of mixing elements serves as the gateway to an ever-expanding world of items, materials, and phenomena. From the natural elements, players can craft anything from the tangible, like mountains and lakes, to the conceptual, like energy and life. The game's intuitive design encourages exploration and experimentation, rewarding curiosity with surprising and inventive outcomes.

Behind Infinite Elements's seemingly straightforward gameplay lies a deep and engaging experience, driven by an AI that continuously introduces new and unexpected combinations. This feature ensures that the game remains fresh and exciting, as players can never predict what their next combination will yield. Whether it's combining fire and water to create steam or merging earth and air to summon a storm, the results are as limitless as the player's imagination. description: Mock Locations app allows you to fake GPS location information for all apps installed on your device. The app spoofs location information by GPS and Network providers. Fake GPS location in route mode: Just set start and end points on the map and the app will automatically build a route along the roads, and then set the speed and how long you want to stay at the start and end points of the route. When you press the play button, the Mock Locations app starts changing your GPS coordinates step by step, as if you were actually driving that route. You can add as many parking points as you want. If you want to fly gps location as airplane (on a straight line without roads) open app's settings and deselect the "On the roads" option. If you don't need to simulate a route and you want to fake gps location in one point, just set only one point on the map and press the start button. The location changer algorithm will mock gps location of your device at this point with little fluctuations of GPS coordinates (to simulate fluctuations of the real GPS signal). Fake GPS location in joystick mode: If you want to manually change GPS location of the device you can use joystick. The Mock Locations app will display the joystick over other apps and you will be able to control your fake location from other app. (For this the app needs the "Display over other apps" permission.) Fake GPS location in GPX file playback mode: If you have recorded your real trip to the GPX file you can open it in this app and replay it as a fake GPS route trip. The Mock Locations app will help in debugging GPS location based apps or if you want no one to know where you really are. Attention! Before purchasing the Full Version of the app check how it works on your device. For this there is a free trial period of 24 hours after installing the app. During this time, you can use all premium features. Features: - Location spoofing by GPS and Network providers. - Ability to create a route on roads. - Ability to set breakpoints and specify the stay in them. - Ability to set a variable speed. - Closed route. (Allows you to build a route for movement along a closed path. To do this, lay the route so that the start and end points were near.) - You can use the braking before bends. Mahjong Fortune: Classic Tile Matching Puzzle

Mahjong Fortune is a traditional tile-matching solitaire puzzle game. Match pairs of identical open tiles to clear the board and solve hundreds of challenging layouts.

How to Play:
• Tap two identical Mahjong tiles to remove them from the board.
• Tiles must be "open" (unblocked) — meaning they have no tiles covering them and at least one free side (left or right).
• Clear all tiles from the board to complete the level and unlock the next puzzle.

Key Features:
• Hundreds of Solitaire Levels: Play through custom-designed tile layouts with progressive difficulty.
• Classic & Seasonal Themes: Choose from traditional Mahjong tile sets or modern visual themes.
• Helpful Boosters:

Hint: Highlights a valid matching pair when you are stuck.

Shuffle: Rearranges all remaining open tiles on the board to create new matches.

Undo: Take back your last move.
• Offline Play: Enjoy the full game without an internet or Wi-Fi connection.
• Customization: Change board backgrounds and tile artwork to suit your preference.

Disclaimer:
Mahjong Fortune is a free-to-play single-player puzzle game intended solely for casual entertainment. It does not feature real-money gambling, cash prizes, or payout mechanisms.

Solitairescapes is here! Relax and unwind with a game of Solitaire surrounded by stunning views. It’s the classic card game you love, now set in the most beautiful scenes!

We’ve removed all unnecessary features to give you a clean and intuitive experience. It’s no-fuss Solitaire, with a beautiful design that lets you simply play!

Solitairescapes is the perfect game to help you relax and keep you sharp. It is played in the style of Klondike Solitaire, also known as Patience — the most popular card game in the world! With every new game, you’ll get a new deck of cards and a brand new design: play from the mountains to jungles, from sand-swept deserts to the crystal glaciers.

Try out our daily challenge to collect golden trophies, or play unlimited decks for free! You can choose between winnable decks (guaranteed to be solvable) or try your luck with a totally random game. Feel free to play the game your way, with a 1 card or 3 card draw, and choose between classic or Vegas style scoring.

Featuring:

- Classic Klondike Solitaire gameplay
- Beautiful photo backgrounds
- Fun daily challenges
- Offline play
- Detailed player statistics
- Unlimited free undo
- Unlimited free hints
- Customizable card and table design
- Vegas and Classic Solitaire scoring modes
- Cumulative Vegas scoring
- Random or Winnable solitaire decks
- Left-Handed Mode
- Support for iPad
- Beautiful HD Graphics

Have you never played Solitaire before?

Klondike Solitaire uses a standard 52 card deck of playing cards without jokers. The objective of the game is to expose all cards and move them into the foundation piles. There are 4 foundation piles (one for each suit) that are represented on the screen by an “A” written on it. These piles are built upward in suit from Aces to Kings.

In Solitaire there are 7 tableau columns that are built downward (in decreasing rank from Kings to Aces) in alternating colours (red and black). The aim of the game is to clear all the rows into the suitable foundation piles.

If you enjoy gin rummy, spider solitaire, or other card games, you’ll pick up klondike solitaire in no time!

Solitairescapes is a great opportunity to improve your problem-solving skills, relax and have fun! Return to the timeless PC classic as it comes to your phone so that you can play it anytime, anywhere!

Thanks again for playing, and as always If you have any suggestion please let us know at solitairescapessupport@tripledotstudios.com

Type any country name. If you're wrong, Flaggle tells you:
→ Which continent the answer is in
→ How far away your guess was (in km)

PICK YOUR DIFFICULTY
Classic - the flag is right there in full. Just figure out whose it is.
Hard - the flag starts hidden, split into sections. Each wrong guess

Daily - one shared flag for everyone, every day. Tracks your stats and

Hit share when you're done and your result copies as a grid of coloured squares (Wordle-style, no spoilers). Send it to friends and see who got it in fewer guesses.

description:
"A billiards game that’s all about precision over power — Pool One-Shot turns a classic sport into a quick, thrilling puzzle! You get one shot to line up the perfect angle: strike the white ball and send as many colored balls as possible into the pockets. But here’s the catch — if the white ball sinks too, your round ends immediately.

Start with simple layouts: a few colored balls clustered near pockets, wide open angles for easy strikes. As you level up, the challenge spikes — colored balls hide behind obstacles, pockets get narrower, and the white ball sits precariously close to pocket edges. You’ll need to calculate every bounce, control the white ball’s trajectory after impact, and prioritize high-value colored balls for bigger scores.

With crisp, realistic billiards visuals, satisfying clinking sounds, and instant score feedback, it’s the perfect game for quick skill checks. No endless rounds — just one shot to prove your precision, one chance to beat your high score. Can you sink a dozen colored balls in one go without losing the white ball?"
summary: Pool One-Shot! Sink more colored balls, keep white ball safe!

This solitaire card game is easy to understand and rewards careful decisions. A King clears on its own because it is worth 13. • Find two uncovered cards with a total value of 13.
• Jacks count as 11, Queens as 12, and Kings as 13.
• Remove available pairs to uncover new cards and create more options.
• Study the layout before choosing which pair to clear.
• Keep opening the pyramid until every card is gone or no moves remain.

TOOLS FOR A MORE FLEXIBLE PUZZLE
Automatic hints help when a valid pair is difficult to spot. Unlimited undo lets you revisit a move, compare another route, and learn how one choice changes the rest of the pyramid card puzzle. There is no need to rush; each deal gives you time to examine the layout and build a strategy.

- From Simple to Clever
Early levels are gentle and welcoming, with just a few colors and plenty of room to move. As you progress, more screws, more nuts, and tighter arrangements appear — turning each puzzle into a quietly rewarding brain teaser that keeps you engaged without ever feeling unfair.
- Satisfying Every Time
When the last nut clicks into place and a messy screw becomes a flawless single-color stack, the moment is pure satisfaction. Smooth animations and gentle sound effects make every completion feel like a small victory.
Why You’ll Love Nut Stack：Sort Puzzle:
- If you love sorting, organizing, and tidying things up, this game was made for you.
- If you enjoy puzzle games that let you play at your own speed — on the couch, on a break, or winding down at night — you’ll feel right at home.
- If you’re looking for a distraction-free game that keeps your mind quietly engaged without stress, this is it.
- If you find joy in watching scattered pieces come together into perfect order, you’ll keep coming back for more.

🎮GAME FEATURES

🀄Pair tiles in the tray
Move matching mahjong-inspired tiles into the tray above the board. Completing a pair removes both tiles and opens space for another selection.

A tile that looks convenient may not be the safest move. Consider the visible layout, the covered pieces, and the remaining room in the tray before tapping.

👓Comfortable play for adults and seniors
Large, readable tile designs and straightforward touch controls make the game easy to follow. The measured pace gives adults and older players time to examine the board without requiring fast reactions.

🔍Exercise observation and planning
Each puzzle encourages visual attention, pattern recognition, memory, and planning. Short sessions can provide a focused break, while longer sessions offer a more involved challenge.

🧩Different layouts to explore
Progress through stages with changing board structures, tile arrangements, and levels of complexity. New layouts keep the matching process from feeling repetitive.

💡Helpful tools
When a puzzle becomes difficult, a hint can point out a possible match, while the shuffle option rearranges the remaining tiles for a fresh perspective. Use the undo tool to take back your most recent selection and try a different approach.

📱Play offline
Puzzles remain available when an internet connection is not. Play during a quiet break, at home, or while traveling.

Mahjong Spark: Tile Match suits players who enjoy tile matching, sorting puzzles, visual challenges, and relaxing single-player games. Its simple controls make it approachable for beginners, while the tray limit gives experienced players room to develop their own strategy.

Welcome to Gaps Solitaire, a clever twist on traditional solitaire that challenges your memory, planning, and strategy. With simple rules and deeply satisfying gameplay, Gaps is the perfect card game for anyone who enjoys puzzles, brain games, and solitaire with a twist.

Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned solitaire fan, Gaps offers a fresh and stimulating experience that keeps you coming back for more.

Gaps (also known as "Spaces" or "Montana") is a unique solitaire game using a single deck of 52 cards. Your goal is to organize the cards into four perfect sequences from 2 through King, all arranged in suit and in order.

The twist? You can only move cards into adjacent spaces, and there are no stacking moves. It's a logic puzzle that tests your brain in the best way possible.

🃏 Core Gameplay Features
• Clear and intuitive controls
• One-touch movement and smart card highlights
• Easy-to-learn rules with endless depth
• Track your best times and scores
• Restart or reshuffle when you need a fresh shot

🎯 Strategic & Relaxing
Gaps Solitaire is a relaxing game that still rewards strategic thinking. Plan carefully and make each move count. The simple layout makes it easy to focus, and the built-in hints or reshuffles are there if you get stuck.

🎨 Clean Design, Smooth Experience
• Crisp cards and minimalist interface
• Light & dark modes for comfortable play
• Responsive animations with no unnecessary distractions
• Landscape and portrait orientations supported

📶 Offline & On-the-Go
No internet? No problem. Gaps Solitaire is fully playable offline, making it a perfect travel companion or break-time brain teaser.

💡 Why You’ll Love Gaps Solitaire
• Combines card game fun with logic puzzle challenge
• Great for fans of FreeCell, Solitaire, or Sudoku
• Every round is a fresh puzzle—no two games are the same
• Perfect mix of relaxing play and mental engagement

► PICTURE PUZZLE GAMES WITH A FALLING TWIST

Complete a piece of the image, watch it dissolve — and new tiles come tumbling down to fill the empty space. Jigsflow blends jigsaw matching, block-space strategy and solitaire associations into one smooth, flowing puzzle game with gentle brain training built in.

► HOW TO PLAY

● Slide pieces around the grid to complete parts of the picture
● Treat every board as an association puzzle and find what belongs together
● Match connected tiles and clear the finished section
● Watch fresh pieces fall into the gap and reshape the grid
● Guard your empty cells and plan a few moves ahead, just like in a block puzzle
● Take your time — enjoy calm, relaxing games with no clock and no pressure

► ONE SIMPLE IDEA, ENDLESS BOARDS

Every stage is an association puzzle: spot the pieces that belong together, join them, and let them go. The more you play, the faster you learn to read edges, colors and patterns, until finding the right connection feels almost instinctive.

No timer, no pressure — just logic puzzles that reward a patient eye and smart decisions. Solve a quick board in a spare minute or ride the cascade for as long as you like.

► GAME FEATURES

EVERY CLEAR RESHUFFLES THE BOARD

Each completed section drops a fresh wave of tiles into the gap, changing the board and creating new possibilities with every clear.

SOLITAIRE FLOW, JIGSAW HEART
A relaxed take on solitaire associations: read the board, spot the match, and chain one clear into the next. Soon you will see connections before the pieces settle.

DEEPLY SATISFYING FEEDBACK
Soft animations and melting tiles make every connection feel rewarding — all the comfort of classic relaxing games, with plenty of challenge underneath.

A GALLERY WORTH RESTORING
Discover hand-picked artwork across a growing library of picture puzzle games. Complete each scene piece by piece and watch the full picture come together.

BLOCK STRATEGY ON EVERY GRID
Space is your most valuable resource. These logic puzzles are as much about keeping room for the next drop as about matching the pieces in front of you. Think ahead and protect your empty cells.

PLAY WHENEVER YOU WANT
A spare minute on the train, a quiet break during the day, or a relaxing evening on the sofa — quick sessions and a pressure-free pace fit naturally into your day.

A MENTAL WORKOUT THAT FEELS LIKE A BREAK
Sharpen your focus, memory and logic skills while you unwind, combining thoughtful play with the satisfying rhythm of matching and clearing.

► WHY PLAYERS KEEP COMING BACK

This is more than a traditional jigsaw. Unlike most picture puzzle games, the grid never sits still. Calm early boards gradually grow into dense layouts where one careless move can cost you precious space — and a clever chain of clears can open it right back up.

The difficulty grows naturally as you play, while the relaxing pace keeps things enjoyable even when the board gets tight. Experienced players will find plenty of depth too, with pure logic and forward planning becoming vital as new pieces keep falling.

Each new association puzzle brings another picture to restore, another board to master, and another satisfying cascade to set in motion.

► START MATCHING TODAY

Tap play, find the connections, and watch the pieces melt away in one long, satisfying flow. One puzzle game, endless evolving grids, and a whole gallery of pictures waiting to be restored.

If you love solitaire associations, clever matching and relaxing puzzles with a strategic twist, JigsFlow is easy to pick up — and hard to put down.

Download JigsFlow and let the pieces fall into place!

Twenty-Nine

is a South Asian trick-taking card game.Twenty-Nine is generally a four-player game with two partnerships. Partners face each other during play. The game utilizes only 32 cards of a standard 52 card deck, 8 cards per suit. The cards rank as follows: J (high), 9, A, 10, K, Q, 8, 7 (low).

Cards values are as follows:

Jacks: 3 points Nines: 2 points Aces: 1 point Tens: 1 point K, Q, 8, 7: 0 points This gives a total of 28 points. Some variations have a total of 29 points for the last trick, which is how it received its namesake. However, the game is generally not played that way and still retains the name.

THE DEAL & THE BIDDING

The deal and gameplay pass to the left. The dealer shuffles the deck and the player to their right cuts it. Each player receives four cards, one at a time, face-down. Depending on the cards in hand, players place bids for electing trumps. A bid is a number that represents the number of tricks that a person believes their partnership can make. The highest bidder wins. The bid starts with the player to the left of the dealer and moves left. Players can raise the bid or pass. The winner of the bidding selects the trump suit. The dealer passes each player another 4 cards. Each player now has 8 cards.

THE PLAY

The first track starts with the player to the left of the dealer. Each player must follow suit if they can. At this point, the trump suit is unknown to all other players. The first player who is unable to follow suit is required to ask the bidder what the trump suit is and they must show the trump suit to everyone. However, if the bidder is the first player who is unable to follow suit they must declare to everyone what the trump suit is. Once the trump is declared the highest value card from that suit played wins the trick, if no trump card is played then it is the highest value card of the suit led. In the event, the bidder or their partner announces they have a Pair, their bid is reduced by four, as long as their bid remains above the 15 point minimum. However, if the other partner has the Pair it increases the bid by 4, as long as it doesn’t exceed 28.

THE SCORING

After all 8 tricks have been taken, the partnerships total the value of the cards they have won. The winners of the last trick add an additional point to their total. If the bidding partnership fulfilled their contract by taking the required number of tricks they won a single game point. If not, they lose a game point. The other set of partners' scores remains constant. The red and black sixes are used for keeping score. The red six (nali or red chaka) displays the positive score and The black six displays the negative score with the number of pips it has revealed. At the start, each partnership has no pips showing. Pips are revealed as players lose or gain points. The game can end in one of two ways: one team has +6 points or one team has -6 points. Unlike traditional water sort games, this loopy system requires you to think in cycles. Every move flows through the loop, so planning ahead and timing your actions are key. The concept of loopkey—understanding how the system flows—helps you solve levels more efficiently.

Sudoku rules 

The objective of the game is to fill a 9x9 grid so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3x3 boxes (also called blocks or regions) contains the digits from 1 to 9. 

A cell is the smallest block in the game. A row, column and region consists of 9 cells and the whole game consists of 81 cells. 

How to win in Sudoku

I most basic strategy to find missing numbers is scanning and it consists of
1) Cross-hatching.  
2) Counting.

1) Crosshatching. Player scan rows and columns to eliminate where a specific number can be in a given region. There is only one legal place left for the each number in each row, column, or box. 

2)Counting. In counting you simply count all the different numbers that's in a row, column and region that connects to one cell. if there is just one number missing then thats what should be in the cell.

A picture gently comes to life. Snow drifts past a glowing cabin. Lanterns sway above a night market. Otters turn slowly through the water.

Then the picture breaks into pieces. As you rebuild it, the world inside keeps moving.

BUILD IT YOUR WAY

There is no frame to fill and no fixed grid to follow. Connect the first two pieces and the picture begins to grow from there. Start from the centre, build separate clusters, or follow the colours that catch your eye. Where you begin and how you progress are entirely up to you.

THE CHALLENGE IS IN THE PICTURE

Early levels guide you with bold shapes and distinct colours. As you progress, the artwork reveals less: repeating leaves, stretches of ice with no clear position, patterns that echo at exactly the size of a piece. Later pictures become a true test of patience and observation.

NOT EVERY PIECE THAT FITS IS RIGHT

Sometimes a piece settles perfectly into the wrong place—and the game will let it stay. When the surrounding picture refuses to come together, you will need to find the piece that misled you and think again. Move it to its rightful place, and everything else begins to fall into line.

NO NEED TO RUSH

No timers. No lives. No losing. If you want to track your time and moves, you can see them at the end of each level. Leave halfway through a picture and everything will be waiting exactly where you left it. The challenge comes from the image, never from pressure.

MADE TO BE TOUCHED

Large, flat pieces designed for your thumb. Every connection lands with a satisfying click you can hear and feel. If you love the quiet focus of a jigsaw puzzle, you will find that same absorbing pleasure here in a different form.

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT

Begin with three hints and earn more as you play. Each hint places a single piece where it belongs—just enough help to keep you moving, without solving the puzzle for you.

HIGHLIGHTS

* Living pictures that continue moving as you solve them
* A gentle beginning that grows into a genuine challenge
* Free-form assembly with no frame or fixed grid
* Pieces that can fit in the wrong place
* Large blocks designed for one-handed play
* Calming ambient sound, muted with a tap
* Hints earned through play
* Progress saved automatically
* No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up

Ten minutes before sleep. A bus ride. A quiet waiting room. One picture at a time.

Ludo is a board game that originated in India. It is derived from an ancient Indian game called Pachisi. It is very similar to the Spanish game - ‘Parchis’ and the American game - ‘Parcheesi’.  

Basic rules for playing Ludo:
• Each player has four tokens.
• The board is set up with each player's tokens on their respective starting spaces.
• Players take turns rolling a dice to determine how many spaces they can move their tokens.
• If a player rolls a six, they get an extra turn.
• Players can move their tokens clockwise around the board.
• If a player lands on a space occupied by one of their opponent's token, the opponent's token is sent back to the starting space.
• The first player to get all of their tokens to the centre of the board, known as "home," wins the game.

Klondike Solitaire uses a standard 52 card deck of playing cards without jokers. The objective of the game is to expose all cards and move them into the foundation piles. Continue adjusting ring sizes and guiding the arrow until it reaches the goal.

Play a captivating game of Hearts. To win you must avoid getting the scoring cards. Or you can Shoot the Moon. The game is over when one of the four players gains more or exactly 100 points. You win if you have the smallest score. Though chance is involved you can still make the best of your cards and win. 


FEATURES

- Easy to use and play
- Advanced AI players

- Balanced rules

TIPS

- You can keep low and try to earn the lowest score by avoiding cards of hearts and especially by avoiding the 13-points Queen of Spades. 
- Another strategy is to go big and take all the hearts and the Queen of Spades, in which case you "Shoot the Moon". It will either take 26 points away or add 26 points to all your opponents. When at least one player goes over or reaches 100 points the game is over.
- The scoring cards are the cards of hearts, each worth 1 point, and the Queen of Spades, worth 13 points. Whoever plays the highest card of the suit that started the trick collects the trick. The value of the cards grows in this order 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, Jack, Queen, King and Ace.
- 13 cards are dealt to each player. Before every hand, each player has to choose 3 cards and pass them to another player with one exception. For every fourth hand no cards are passed. The player holding the 2 of clubs must lead to begin the first trick.
- Players must follow suit. If you don't have a card of the suit which started the trick you can place any card.
- Players can start tricks with a card from any suit, with one exception: the cards of hearts. Placing a card of hearts in the trick for the first time is called breaking the hearts. Once the hearts are broken you can start a trick with a card of hearts.
- Sometimes you can collect all the scoring cards and thus you shoot the moon. In most cases you will receive 0 points and the others will each receive 26 points.
- However, if by adding 26 points to other players they gain more than 100 points, but you still lose, another solution is preferred. In this case 26 points will be subtracted from your score and all the other players will keep their scores.
- By default the set difficulty is easy. But you can change it from the main menu. To enter the main menu and to also pause the game just press on the button in the top left corner of the screen. You can change it from easy to medium, from medium to hard or from hard to easy. And the next time when you play a new hand, the AI will employ better strategies or not depending on your preferred difficulty level.

description:
Web Video Caster® allows you to watch on your TV videos from your favorite websites including movies, TV shows, live streams of news, sports.

SUPPORTED STREAMING DEVICES

Web Video Caster® supports the most popular streaming devices, allowing your TV to stream videos directly from the web.

• Google Cast (Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in)
• DLNA devices like Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs, etc. 
• Roku, Roku stick and Roku TVs
• Apple TV 4
• Fire TV and Fire TV stick
• PlayStation 4 - by using its web browser
• Most web browsers by visiting http://cast2tv.app (PS4, Smart TVs, other consoles and set top boxes)


*If you experience a compatibility issues, contact us and include the brand and model number.

SUPPORTED MEDIA

• HLS live streams in M3U8 format (Chromecast, most DLNA devices lack support for it)
• Authenticated videos including movies and TV shows
• MP4 videos
• Live news and sports
• Any HTML5 videos*


*Your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video you are playing. Web Video Caster doesn't perform any video/audio decoding or transcoding.

HOW IT WORKS

Web Video Cast™ is a browser, which allows you to stream videos of movies, TV shows, and other media from the internet to a streaming device or smart tv. Web Video Caster grabs the video URL inside the web page, sends it to the streaming device (i.e. Chromecast or DLNA device), and then plays the video directly from the content provider. This ultimately saves your mobile device’s battery. It also detects subtitles on the web page. Web Video Cast™ does not host these videos. This is not a mirroring app.


GET STARTED

Follow these simple step-by-step instructions to start streaming:

1. Find a video online that you want to watch.

2. Make sure this video can play on mobile browsers without Flash.

3. Connect to your streaming device.

4. Play the video as you normally would. Or, click the play button on the toolbar.

PREMIUM FEATURES**

• No in-app advertising
• Most visited sites
• Bookmarks
• Set homepage

**This functionality does not apply universally to all streaming devices. 

LIMITATIONS & DISCLOSURES

As with all apps, there are some limitations we are aware of and want you to know about up front.

• We are in no way associated with any web media providers and we do not have control over the content they provide.
• Web Video Caster does not support nor play Flash or FLV videos.
• The app does not support tab casting, like the Chromecast extension for the PC web browser.
• We cannot do anything to fix issues that arise on the server side (media content provider) such as failure to play or buffering, which is especially common during heavy load times and weekends.


SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK

We are committed to open communication with our users. Please contact us first with any questions or support issues before leaving a review. We will respond and address your concern promptly. Contact us through our website http://www.webvideocaster.com/contactForm

How to Play
The goal is to board every passenger onto the bus that matches their color.

Tap to Move: Tap on groups of colored characters at the bottom of the screen to send them onto the track.

Follow the Track: Characters automatically move along the path toward the loading zone.

Match the Bus: Characters will only board a bus of the same color.

Manage the Sequence: If you send a group that doesn't match the current bus, they will wait on the track. Be careful—if the track fills up and blocks the path for the correct color, you fail the level.

Strategic Sorting: Move beyond simple matching. You must plan the correct order of taps to prevent gridlock.

Dynamic Gameplay: Experience a "flow" mechanic where movement and track space are your primary challenges.

Game rules: There are between two and four players and 32 cards. Every player always has a hand of three cards and one to three lives indicated by matchsticks. You get points for cards of the same suit: Rank cards are worth the same as their number (7, 8, 9, 10). Face cards are worth 10 and aces are worth 11 points. Another special card combination comprises three cards of equal points value - those make up 31½

You can do one of four possible actions each round:

- Swap your entire hand with the three cards in the center

A sudoku puzzle is a grid of nine by nine squares, which is additionally further divided into nine sub-grids of three by three squares each. Follow our tips in the game as well.

The numbers 1 to 9 must be entered into the sudoku puzzle in such a way that:
- in each horizontal row each number appears only once
- in each vertical column each number appears only once
- in each sub grid each number occurs only once
